author: DiscoJUGADOR
body: Hey! I would like to get unbanned, because I got banned for ban evasion because I gave this account to a friend for a few days and he was banned on Avicus, (I didn't know about that) and he tried to record a report with my account, and a mod saw my nickname there and banned him (me) for ban evasion. I know this was my fault and I'm sorry about this, but this was 1 year ago...
